name: doc-anonymizer
description: 工作区根: Python 五个包(packages/, requirements-dev.txt) + 前端(website/ 官网, packages/ui 组件库, apps/web 产品界面)

scripts.setup: ./scripts/dev.sh setup && npm install && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: npm run check -w @doc-anonymizer/ui && npm run build -w @doc-anonymizer/website && npm run build:web
